name: Raintech Product Cleanup for WooCommerce
author: raintech357

sections.description:
Raintech Delete Bulk Products For WooCommerce gives store managers a dedicated admin tool to permanently or softly delete large numbers of WooCommerce products in one go, using fine-grained filters.

Filters available:

  • Product Status (Published, Draft, Pending, Private, Trash)
  • Categories (multi-select)
  • Tags (multi-select)
  • Stock Status (In Stock, Out of Stock, On Backorder)
  • Product Type (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate)
  • Created Date Range (from / to)
  • Price Range (min / max)

Delete options:

  • Soft-delete (move to Trash) or permanently delete
  • Optionally delete attached product images from the media library

Preview before you delete:

Use the Preview Products button to see a paginated table of all matching products before committing. The delete action processes products in safe batches of 50 with a live progress bar.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the raintech-delete-bulk-products folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Bulk Delete Products
